message: _state in request properties is always undefined — a request is evaluated on the server with an empty state. Pass the value in the payload and read it with _payload.
visible: false removes the block and its state. Style it hidden (for example style: { display: none }) to keep the value.
A Link to the page already open does not remount it, so onMount does not fire again. Trigger the reload chain from the same action list.
A _ref to a .njk file renders at build, so _state, _request and _user are undefined inside it. Use _nunjucks over a .txt file for a template that needs runtime values.
A _ref to a .js file imports it as a module rather than reading it as text. Name the file .js.txt to read its source.

This request runs over a tenant-walled connection. The wall injects { $match: { <tenant field> } } into the top-level pipeline and into every $lookup / $unionWith sub-pipeline, so a lookup into a collection with no tenant field returns [] with no error. Run the request over the shared connection and pass tenant facts in the payload instead.
:reject is the routine's reply, not an exception. A :catch never runs for it, :finally does, and :throw is the caught path.
